name: cTSWantSimulatorTuningLoader::LoadTuning (cTSWantSimulator's tuning step: clears the category wants and the +0x68 want vector, loads record {0, 0xcda53b6f, 0x2d7ee26b, 0}, parses it with the framework's expat parser through our loader; default level thresholds when the record is missing)
notes: Hooked (lane IL, adapter: thiscall to static). Difftest WantTuningLoader_Load: 1500 seeds; a scripted parser (fake slot 3 replays random start/end element events with random attributes, both sides receiving the same script) drives the game's loader (original) and ours; compares the event log of every fake call (resource manager, record, stream, framework, parser, object table, career definitions, curves, want stand-ins), the simulator's members (category wants, level tables, aspiration curves, skill and career sets, +0x68 vector), the fakes' refcounts and the unknown-tag sets (the image's statics 0x10daa7c/0x10daa88 against ours). Scripts always start with wantSimulator, an aspiration and a level element: the original leaves +0x4/+0x10/+0x14/+0x38 unset at construction (ours zero), so an early read is undefined. Mutants (tools/mutate.py, filter WantTuningLoader, 29 across the class): 27 killed; equivalent survivors: Assign's same-object check removed (a new curve can never equal the held one, which the field still references), number parsed as uint32 instead of uint16 (truncated to int16 in param.extra either way). Not run in game.

name: cTSWantSimulatorTuningLoader::Release (refcount at +8; destroys the four sets and sized-deletes 0x3c at zero)
notes: Difftest WantTuningLoader_Slots (300 seeds): a game loader built through the image's operator new 0x824632 with the game vtable against ours (new); QI with iids 1, kIid 0x4b6b9c9b, others; AddRef/Release sequences, refcount and heap state compared. In effect through its callers (lane IL): only the game vtable 0xdcae44 refers to the original and only LoadTuning's original 0x494030 stores it; with the LoadTuning hook every loader is ours, so the host traps the original under that switch.

name: cTSWantSimulatorTuningLoader::StartElement (wantSimulator/aspiration/level/threshold/curve/category/want/skill/career elements into the owning cTSWantSimulator)
notes: Covered by WantTuningLoader_Load (see 0x494030): every element and attribute name of the cells 0x1012d28..0x1012e00 is drawn by the script generator, plus unknown names. Threshold index out of range writes table[0] (ORIGINAL-BUG reproduced). In effect through its callers (lane IL): see 0x494830.

name: cTSWantSimulatorTuningLoader::EndElement (closes modes, sorts and monotonises level thresholds, folds the career sets)
notes: Covered by WantTuningLoader_Load (see 0x494030). In effect through its callers (lane IL): see 0x494830.
